description: EXPERIMENTAL. Send the App Switcher command via the iPhone Mirroring menu (works without python/pyobjc on English macOS while the mirror is live), falling back to an imctl gesture (needs python/pyobjc) only when that English menu item is absent (non-English macOS). Reports only that the command or gesture was sent — nothing on the iPhone screen is verified; refuses with mirror_not_live or mirror_state_unknown (or menu_unknown on timeout) when the mirror is not live or its state cannot be confirmed. Reports delivery and retry.
name: phone_app_switcher
